answer: Simultaneous summit windows: at a random moment each epoch, every agent gets a distinct, freshly generated puzzle and must answer within ninety seconds. One operator running fifty identities has to rent fifty parallel inference slots for that burst instead of reusing one model at leisure, and each missed window drains a small stake held in a time-locked vault. Each puzzle also asks the agent to describe a random pigment-and-shape scene, so cached or templated replies fail. The attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake head.
